```{r load_packages, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(pixelatorR)
library(Seurat)
library(harmony)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplotify)
library(tidygraph)
library(pcaMethods)
library(pbapply)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggrastr)
source("theme.R")
source("utility.R")
```


# Plotting

## Proximity and abundance 

```{r load_data, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

plot_data <- 
  read_csv("../data/microscopy_data_Values.csv")

plot_data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(`Distance_(microns)`, Gray_Value)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Distance (microns)", y = "Gray Value")
ggsave("../results/microscopy_plot.pdf", width = 4, height = 3, dpi = 300)
```
